description: Defines the QuicControlFrameManager class responsible for managing control frames in QUIC protocol, including buffering, retransmission, and acknowledgment handling.

classes.name: QuicControlFrameManager
classes.description: Manages control frames in QUIC, handling their transmission, acknowledgment, retransmission, and buffering.

classes.name: QuicControlFrameManager::DelegateInterface
classes.description: Interface for delegate callbacks related to control frame errors and writing control frames.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferGoAway
methods.description: Attempts to send or buffer a GOAWAY control frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferWindowUpdate
methods.description: Attempts to send or buffer a WINDOW_UPDATE frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferBlocked

methods.name: WriteOrBufferHandshakeDone
